question: The inspiration to build temperature regulated green homes at IIT Kanpur in 2012 came from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cocoon structure**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The inspiration to build temperature regulated green homes at IIT Kanpur in 2012 came from the **cocoon structure**.
 
• The **cocoon structure** is an architectural design that helps in maintaining optimal temperature within the building, reducing the need for artificial heating and cooling systems.
 
• This design is particularly effective in extreme weather conditions, providing a sustainable and energy-efficient solution.
 
• Such innovations are part of a broader effort to incorporate green building practices and promote environmental sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Green homes are designed to be environmentally friendly and resource-efficient throughout their lifecycle, from siting to design, construction, operation, maintenance, renovation, and demolition.
 
• Key features of green homes include the use of renewable energy sources, efficient use of water, improved indoor air quality, and the use of sustainable building materials.
 
• Institutions like IIT Kanpur are at the forefront of research and development in sustainable architecture and green technologies.
